head_commit.message:
evidence(282): align c100 wall with contract formula and record J1-J4 judgments

- c100 entries now report wallSeconds as the contract formula
  max(completed_at) - min(started_at): 384.0 / 453.0 / 436.0s. The run-level
  values (385 / 462 / 438s) move to runWallSeconds.
- mergesPerHour formula no longer says the contract has no definition; the
  definition now lives in docs/spec/ci_critical_path_metric.md section 2.6,
  added by PR #303.
- record J1-J4 applicability instead of leaving it implicit. Per
  ci_optimization_tcb_judgments.md:255 a candidate is VALID only if all four
  PASS. J1 and J2 are PARTIAL with the observation that supports them (one
  49s overlap, identical context/issuer sets); J3 and J4 are N/A because the
  change touches no cache key or worker scheduling. No VALID claim is made.
